name: 08066 · Paulsboro, NJ
findings: ZIP 08066 (Paulsboro) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08066 (Paulsboro) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
